title: THE EXTRACT INBOUND COUNTDOWN IS THE BIG NUMBER SIZE
why: Critic on screen 37: the extraction state was three small cues with no hero, the timer about 28px. The inbound line now takes the big-number size (39px at 1080p) with its words unchanged.
now: While extraction is inbound the countdown line is drawn at the big number size.

edits.anchor: function hudFS(spec){ var f=FS(spec), r=Math.max(1,(typeof hudRes==='function')?hudRes():1); return (r===1)?f:f.replace((/([\d.]+)px/),function(m0,n0){ return (parseFloat(n0)*r).toFixed(1)+'px'; }); }
